splash.description: After its attack, hit or miss, the target and each creature within this many feet of it make the save (Ice Knife: 5): a card of its own

typeOptions.description: The damage is one of these types, chosen when casting or determined as the text says (Chromatic Orb, Dragon's Breath, Prismatic Spray's ray roll); `type` is the default

on.description: In a spell with both an attack and a save (Ice Knife), what this damage rides on: the attack's hit, or the save (with `splash`)

choice.description: A group of alternatives: the spell imposes one of them (Blindness/Deafness: "your choice"). The card ticks the group's first; the DM picks another

stage.description: A later stage, not landed on the first failed save (Sleep's Unconscious on a second failure, Flesh to Stone's Petrified after the third): the DM ticks it when it comes

pick.description: The DM judges whether it applies (Divine Word by the creature's Hit Points, a Prismatic Spray's ray): unticked on the card

until.description: It lasts until the end of the caster's next turn (Color Spray), the start of the caster's next turn (Sunbeam), or the end of the creature's own next turn (Sleep, Holy Aura)

outline.description: Creatures inside are outlined (Faerie Fire): can't benefit from Invisible

speedHalved.description: A creature's Speed is halved while it is inside (Spirit Guardians); distinct from Difficult Terrain

senses.description: Senses the creature it's on gains, in feet (Darkvision 150, True Seeing's Truesight 120)

seeInvisible.description: The creature it's on sees Invisible creatures (See Invisibility)

when.description: enter: a creature enters (or the area moves into its space); startTurn/endTurn: its own turn inside; per5ft: each 5 ft it moves inside; moveInto: the effect's object is moved into its space (Flaming Sphere); action: its caster's action repeats it at a point in the area (Call Lightning)

conditionEnds.description: The condition lasts until the end of the creature's current turn (Stinking Cloud)

breaksConcentration.description: A failed save also ends the creature's Concentration (Sleet Storm)

side.description: A wall's trigger reaches this far out of its damaging side as well as inside it (Wall of Fire: 10 ft)

onAppear.description: Creatures in the area when it appears make the spell's save (Moonbeam, Cloudkill, Wall of Fire); otherwise only its triggers act

oncePerTurn.description: A creature makes its save only once per turn, whichever trigger (Spirit Guardians, Moonbeam)

recastEnds.description: Casting it again ends the caster's earlier one (Light: "the spell ends if you cast it again")

bodyFt.description: An object's diameter at the effect's centre (Flaming Sphere: 5): its area reaches round the object, and it's what moves into a creature's space

strike.description: Where each strike lands, when that isn't the spell's area (Call Lightning's bolt, a 5-ft radius under the cloud): the cast's targets and each action's; the spell's area is then the effect itself
